{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kkak clan''' was a tribe of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Tteel Kkak]] was a member of this clan, and was in charge of one of its [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawlers]]. The clan had its own [[Kkak clan fortress|fortress]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
